scope: Upload Session and integration API PostgreSQL matrix failures; isolated worktree, local disposable schemas only

diagnosis.upload: The owning Upload Session runner omitted the required MEDIA_FETCH_TOOLCHAIN_FINGERPRINT. Atomic ingest handoff correctly refused an input hash without its toolchain identity; the finalization wrapper returned reconciling. Supply the same explicit controlled fingerprint used by other native execution database runners. No production fallback was added.
diagnosis.integrationReplay: Export acceptance remains frozen at editorRevision 0, while replay intentionally reads the current export projection, so an edit changes currentEditorRevision to 1 and isOlderVersion to true. The test still compares the entire response and now independently verifies that the durable receipt result remains unchanged.
diagnosis.integrationCancellation: The obsolete assignedExportRun fixture manually created and rebound another active render run after ClipExportService.create had already atomically accepted one. The database's one-active-run constraint correctly rejected that fixture mutation. The replacement reads and asserts the actual accepted queued, unleased run, then exercises existing native lifecycle and cancellation service calls.

strongerChecks: Creator removal handoff produces exactly one import_pipeline dispatch with the queued job's epoch/generation and the configured toolchain input hash.
Export replay retains the entire accepted export/output/receipt identity while reporting fresh editor-version metadata; persisted receipt result stays immutable.
Cancellation fixtures require every selected export to name the same existing queued render run with zero parent attempts and no parent lease.
contracts: GLOSSARY.md: Upload Session and Ingest Job definitions require exactly-once durable handoff.
GLOSSARY.md: Operation Receipt stores accepted identity and result.
ADR 0019: Postgres owns dispatch obligations; render parents remain unleased and real child starts own charges.
packages/services/src/clip-export.service.ts: create atomically calls handoffClipExportWithinTransaction and refreshes the export projection on receipt replay.

execution.inheritedTestSelectors: removed; launch environment contains only PATH and unchanged HOME before loading the dedicated local env
execution.schemaOwnership: Existing owning runners create and drop their fresh disposable schemas in finally.

limitations: Local database gate repairs only; no cloud/live-resource action or release qualification. The separately investigated full-execution matrix failures are outside this change.
